subject: Request: timeline & export guarantees for immutable admin snapshots (SIG + SOC 2)
messages:
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@solaratherapeutics.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Solara Audit Team <audit@solaratherapeutics.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 / SIG evidence: admin activity snapshot window and guarantees

Jordan — thanks again for taking this. We have a SIG + SOC2 evidentiary request that is focused on admin activity and operator actions. Two things we need explicitly from Redwood for scope in our report and to present to our auditors: (1) the retention policy and whether you can produce an immutable point-in-time snapshot of admin activity for a given tenant (including operator username, action, affected resource, timestamp, and any before/after values), and (2) the timeline and delivery options (S3 presigned, SFTP, signed manifest, checksum).

Key constraints from our side: snapshot must be attested (signed manifest + checksum), PII should be redacted by field where appropriate, and we need an ETA for delivery if we request a 90-day window from today. I attached the questionnaire and an example manifest format. Please let us know what is feasible and any lead times.

Thanks,
Elena Martinez
Head of Compliance
Solara Therapeutics

Attachments: solara_soc2_evidence_questions.xlsx (spreadsheet), export_manifest_template.jsonl (manifest example)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@solaratherapeutics.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 / SIG evidence: admin activity snapshot window and guarantees

Elena — appreciate the clear ask and the manifest example. High-level answers up front:
- What we log: admin actions (console/API), role / identity, resource identifiers, action verb (create/update/delete/privilege-change), request context (IP, region), and before/after where available for mutable resources. We also log session markers for privileged actions.
- Retention: hosted accounts default to 90 days for detailed admin events; Dedicated and Private deployments can be configured to retain up to 24 months (with a contract add-on).
- Immutable snapshots: we can produce an attested, time-bound snapshot (read-only bundle + signed manifest + SHA256 checksums). For hosted customers without Dedicated commitments we provide a snapshot export that is content-equivalent but uses our managed KMS to sign the manifest. For Dedicated/Private customers we can sign manifests with a customer-provided KMS key (HSM-backed) on request.
- Delivery methods & ETA: s3-presigned, sftp, or secure AWS Transfer; typical prep for a 90-day contiguous window is 6-12 hours of pipeline work and verification, plus up to 24 hours for attestation and packaging for hosted accounts. Dedicated snapshots are often faster (2-6 hours) because of pinned storage and prebuilt manifests.

Next steps: adding Kim and Neha here to confirm export file shapes, redaction options (field-level vs. column remove), and custody requirements. If you reply with the exact window (start/end) and whether you need customer-KMS signing, we will run a cost/schedule estimate.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: SOC2 / SIG evidence: admin activity snapshot window and guarantees

Adding technical detail on export shapes and redaction options so we can give Solara precise choices.
1) File formats: newline-delimited JSON (jsonl) and Parquet are both available. jsonl manifest (as Elena provided) is our default for event-level proofs; Parquet is offered for analytics ingestion.
2) Fields included: event_id, tenant_id, operator_id, operator_email (if present), action, resource_type, resource_id, timestamp_utc, request_id, ip_address (hashed on request), before_value (JSON string), after_value (JSON string), signature_metadata.
3) Redaction modes: 
   - Field-level pseudonymization (hash/email-tokenize) — quick, preserves schema
   - Field removal (drop columns) — irreversible, used when auditors request non-recoverable PII removal
   - Tokenization with reversible key (customer-managed) — requires key custody agreement
4) Attestation: manifest will include export window, event count, SHA256 per-file checksum, export generation timestamp, Redwood signer (platform-managed) and optional customer-KMS signing if requested.
5) Chain-of-custody: we include an audit trail for the export job (who requested, job id, generation logs) and a signed manifest. For high-sensitivity requests we can provide a notarized timestamp (third-party) as an add-on.

Operational estimate for a 90-day contiguous window (hosted): data prep 4-8 hours, redaction run 1-3 hours (depending on mode), verification and manifest signing 2-6 hours. Total: 7-17 hours.

If Solara needs a guaranteed SLA for turnaround (e.g., <24 hours), that typically falls into our Reserved/Dedicated offering.

—Kim
Principal Backend Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: export_manifest_template.jsonl

Elena — quick follow-up with the choices to confirm for the export: 
1) Window: please confirm the exact start/end in UTC for the 90-day window you want (we will accept ISO ranges).
2) Delivery & signing: do you need Redwood-managed signing, or will you provide a KMS key for the manifest signature? If customer-KMS, we will initiate the KMS onboarding checklist.
3) Redaction: choose one — pseudonymize (default), drop columns, or tokenization with reversible key (requires custody).
4) Format: jsonl (event-level, recommended) or Parquet (analytics).

Assuming jsonl + pseudonymize + Redwood signing, our target ETA after request acceptance is ~12 hours (we will push a high-priority job). If you need customer-KMS signing and notarization, add 24 hours to allow key exchange and verification.

If you confirm the window and options today we will: (a) provision a ticket, (b) start a dry-run on a 7-day sample to validate manifest shape, (c) produce the full snapshot.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Product Security Manager, Redwood Inference
